sources.title: Run RPBizkit-v2-12B API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: RicardoEstep/RPBizkit-v2-12B is a 12 billion parameter experimental Karcher-Mean merged language model, created by RicardoEstep, combining seven distinct 12B models. This model is designed for roleplay and creative text generation, leveraging a unique merging technique to achieve a stable and high-quality blend of its constituent models.

sources.title: RicardoEstep/RPBizkitRemiX-v1-12B - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: Key Characteristics Architecture: A unique merge of several 12B models, including AngelSlayerKrix-12B, RPBizkit-v2-12B, RPBizkit-v4-12B, RPBizkit-v4-12B_Lorablated, RPBizkit-v5-12B-Lorablated, and RPBizkit-v6-12B. Tokenizer: Features a "Clean Tokenizer & Embedding Sizes (131072)" based on Mistral, contributing to its stability.
